title: [E12-11] ESP32 IMU Sampling and Invalid-Reading Recovery
body:
<!-- nasj-backlog:E12-11 -->

**Parent epic:** https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/13

**User Story:**
As a firmware engineer, I want ESP32/IMU sampling with invalid-reading handling, so the bracelet runs predictably on hardware.

**Epic:** E12 — Optional wearable safety, firmware & privacy  
**Domain:** IoT firmware / Local companion / Privacy  
**Type:** Feature  
**Priority:** P1  
**Target Release:** B — Competition prototype — 10 December 2026  
**Estimated Hours:** TBD — team estimate required  
**Story Points:** 5 — provisional source estimate  
**Sprint / Day:** Unscheduled  
**Assignee:** Unassigned  
**Owner Role:** Firmware/Privacy  
**Status:** Proposed  
**Source PDF Mapping:** US-030  
**Suggested Labels:** `story`, `P1`, `release:B`, `epic:E12`, `iot-firmware`, `local-companion`, `privacy`, `hardware-dependent`

**Dependencies:** [E00-09](https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/81)
**Dependency Provenance:** Source blockers: —; additional proposed blockers: E00-09.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

- [ ] Selected board and IMU documented; data validated; sensor disconnect/out-of-range does not crash; missing hardware clearly noted.
- [ ] Record chosen board/IMU, bus wiring, firmware build and configured sample interval.
- [ ] Validate timestamp/order, finite readings, configured sensor ranges and calibration assumptions.
- [ ] Represent missing/out-of-range/disconnected readings explicitly without crashing or counting them as valid activity.
- [ ] Bound local buffering and recover safely after reconnect/reset.

**Technical Notes / Deliverables:**

Implement a local sampling interface and health-of-device state; raw samples remain in volatile or bounded participant-local storage.

**Verification / Evidence:**

Feed known valid/invalid readings and physically disconnect the available sensor; document recovery and skipped invalid windows.

**Completion Rule:** Attach evidence for all criteria and complete review. Verify applicable permissions, failure states and business invariants. Label synthetic results; individual wearable data never enters commerce.

**Release Boundary:** Use isolated synthetic commercial records and distinguish simulation, observed evidence and physical hardware. This story does not authorize real contracts or live money movement.
